```{r }
library(tidyverse)
input_string <- s
# Define the function
# parse_string_to_tibble <- function(input_string) {
s2df <- function(input_string) {
  # Split the input string by new lines to get individual rows
  rows <- strsplit(input_string, "\n")[[1]]

  # Remove empty rows if any
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)

  # Extract headers and data
  header <- unlist(strsplit(rows[1], ";"))
  data_lines <- rows[-1]

  # Split each data line into columns and create a matrix
  data_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(data_lines, function(line) {
    unlist(strsplit(line, ";"))
  }))

  # Convert the matrix to a tibble
  result_tibble <- as_tibble(data_matrix)

  # Set the column names
  colnames(result_tibble) <- header

  return(result_tibble)
}

# Example usage
s <- "col1;col2
bla1;10
bla2;23
bla3;32
"
s2df(s)
parse_string_to_tibble(s)
```
